blocks.text: Sunnyside Park homes listed and sold, June to September 2026

Sunnyside Park, September 2026. Detached houses: 46 listed at month end and 3 sold in September, a sales ratio of 7% (a buyers’ market). Condos and townhomes: 28 listed at month end and 9 sold in September, a sales ratio of 32% (a sellers’ market).

blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal.

blocks.text: Looking across the period, Detached houses: 18 sold over 4 months against an average of 48.0 listed, about 10.7 months of listings at that pace; the busiest month was June with 7 sold. Condos and townhomes: 35 sold over 4 months against an average of 36.2 listed, about 4.1 months of listings at that pace; the busiest month was June with 11 sold.

faq.q: Is Sunnyside Park the same as Sunnyside Heights?
faq.a: No. The City uses Sunnyside Heights for a Grandview Heights plan area by 168 Street, 24 Avenue and Highway 99, while Sunnyside Park facilities such as Bakerview Park and Sunnyside Community Hall are on 154 Street in South Surrey.

faq.q: Which secondary school is in this area?
faq.a: Semiahmoo Secondary is at 1785 - 148 Street, Surrey, on its SD36 page, and the district locator confirms it serves that address (elementary: H. T. Thrift Elementary) (SD36 School Locator, mybaragar.com, run 2026-11-01); catchment for any other specific address must be checked in the Surrey Schools School Locator.

faq.q: What recreation is in the sub-area?
faq.a: Bakerview Park has Sunnyside Community Hall, a garden, playground, baseball diamonds and a soccer field; Sunnyside Acres Urban Forest offers about 4 km of trails; and the South Surrey Recreation and Arts Centre is at 14601 - 20 Ave.

faq.q: How many units can a house lot hold in Sunnyside?
faq.a: Surrey's SSMUH zoning allows up to 3 units on lots under 280 sq m, up to 4 units on larger lots, and up to 6 units on eligible lots within 400 m of a frequent bus stop.
Peace Arch Hospital is at 15521 Russell Avenue, White Rock, and Fraser Health lists it as a community hospital with emergency, surgery and maternity care.
